dialogues.speaker: The Cage-Maker
dialogues.text: "Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon"! I have come to avenge Elyctra! Prepare your Onikabuto!

dialogues.speaker: The Cage-Maker
dialogues.text: After I defeat you, I'll take down the entire Arataki Gang, one member at a time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like we've got... an adult this time...? And why's this guy even more excitable than the kids?

choices.text: There's no need to be afraid, Paimon.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Well, White-Iron Lavender Melon! Looks like this guy's challenging you to a duel — and there's no backing down from something like that.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Take Crimson Staff with you and go nuts!

choices.text: Just another feather for your cap, Paimon.
